title: Hide stale New response indicator at fractional transcript bottom
outcome: Chromium can report a reachable transcript bottom with a remaining/subpixel 0.5px movement. The detached-tail scroll handler currently requires more than 1px of forward movement before reattaching, so the live-turn card is fully visible at the physical bottom while the floating New response button remains and overlaps it. Accept any positive input-owned movement that lands inside the physical-bottom tolerance and add a regression for the 0.5px final step plus indicator visibility.
